scope: Read-only audit of historical supervised results; independent computations retained

findings.issue: Averaging hierarchical conditional heads is not probability soft voting
findings.remedy: Average a and use abnormal-probability-weighted conditional b, then refit corresponding calibrator

findings.issue: Row-stratified groups yield poor independent-positive recording support
findings.remedy: Balance both per-class row counts and per-class recording presence; repeat grouped development CV

findings.issue: Observed A versus D difference does not establish unique superiority
findings.remedy: Keep test out of reselection; use development-based shortlist and paired uncertainty

findings.issue: Current random-segment estimand weights long recordings more heavily
findings.remedy: Add recording-balanced segment metrics as secondary, with clear estimand

findings.issue: Cache fingerprint omits preprocessing source and runtime package versions
findings.remedy: Fingerprint all behavior-changing sources and dependency versions; immutable new run directory

findings.issue: No independent ensemble arithmetic oracle or minimum positive-recording-support test
findings.remedy: Add targeted regression tests and serialization checks

confirmed_correct: No direct supervised outer/test leakage found
All saved test macro-F1/path recall/AP independently reproduced
Hierarchy second model and calibrator conditional targets are correct
Grouped bootstrap is appropriate for fixed fitted model uncertainty, as documented
Training class weights do not leak into natural-prevalence evaluation
